remarks: Spacious 2 bedrooms/1.5 bathroom updated Townhouse located in South Norwalk! Just minutes away from South Norwalk Station, Sono Mall, I-95/Rt.7 and Merrit Parkway. Perfect for commuters. You'll be able to enjoy the convenience of local restaurants, shops, all within minutes from your front door. Featuring a fireplace, in-unit laundry, hardwood floors, two car garage, jacuzzi/bathtub and central heating ard cooling. With plenty of space to relax and entertain, this condo is perfect for hosting guests or just enjoying some downtime after a long day. Don't miss out on this amazing opportunity to live in one of the most sought-after neighborhoods in Norwalk. LOW utility bills! Photos were taken when the unit was unoccupied. Great credit required.
